name: tiled
description: Create Tiled maps, tilesets, and gameplay object layers and validate their engine imports.

interface.shortDescription: Build tile maps, collisions, and gameplay object layers.
interface.longDescription: Create or edit TMX/TMJ maps and TSX/TSJ tilesets, preserve image references and gameplay properties, export through the local Tiled CLI, and validate the result in the consuming engine. Requires Tiled for editor/CLI checks. No MCP bridge is required. Disabled by default.
defaultPrompt: Create a small Tiled level with a player spawn, collision layer, and goal, then integrate it into this game.
Check this Tiled map's tilesets, object properties, and target-engine import.
